completion_criteria.text: STEP 2 FIRST, ratified before any code: docs/security/bash-gate-threat-model.md with scope, assurance level, adversary model, goals G1-G5, reasoned non-goals, definition of done, escalation control
Step 2 supports: G1-G5 into docs/invariants/registry.json in its existing shape, a 3-5 line pointer in rules/common/security.md, and a ~10-line .claude/hooks/CLAUDE.md
Fail-closed harness: any internal fault forces a blocking verdict rather than trusting the platform, and no-opinion becomes an explicit token so a swallowed exception can never read as allow
G1 merge and G4 guardrail files: server-side branch protection with the hook deny as second layer; path matching against a fixed guardrail list plus chflags uchg friction
G2 and G3: small denylists over the closed enumerable surfaces - gh pr edit, gh api PATCH on pulls, the two GraphQL mutations, MCP update_pull_request, and the PR-create equivalents
G5 exfiltration: narrow parser over named file-reference flags on named network commands, failing to ask on anything unrecognized carrying one; fixes the c5 false positive too
Ship it: invariant-coverage artifact covering every registry id, diff-scoped verification, tests keyed to G1-G5 not to a defect count, one PR via the centralized pr-create tool
